# Marky v1.8.7

A corrective release that restores desktop installers across every supported platform.

### Release reliability

- Fixed a Rust compilation error in the Git SSH askpass setup that blocked the v1.8.6 desktop builds on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Added Rust compilation checks to pull-request CI so backend build errors are caught before a release starts.

This release includes the complete feature set announced for v1.8.6, including Git sync, automatic sync, attachment management, interactive Markdown table editing, and editor and navigation improvements.
